1879048834.name: a melee attack
1879048834.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a two-handed weapon.

1879064066.name: Exchange of Blows
1879064066.desc: You reflect damage to your attacker when hit.

1879064194.name: Invocation of Elbereth
1879064194.desc: Calling upon the Valar can send certain evil foes fleeing in terror for a short time.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Fear replaced with attack speed debuff.</rgb>

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879096322.name: Irresistible Melody
1879096322.desc: You perform a melody so irresistible that all Free Peoples who hear it cannot help but dance.

1879109122.name: Chilling Rhetoric
1879109122.desc: Written words can have a chilling effect on their victim. Slows your foe, but damaging them will return their speed.

1879110402.name: Rune-sign of Flame
1879110402.desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Fire
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with minor elemental powers.

1879145602.name: Guide to Sûri-kylä
1879145602.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Sûri-kylä in Forochel.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879157634.name: Solitary Defender
1879157634.desc: A single target forcet attack that also generates threat.  This skill is used often.

1879198338.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Tundra-eagle)
1879198338.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879207042.name: Steed of Minas Ithil
1879207042.desc: This mount is draped in the colours of the noble and valiant Soldiers of Minas Ithil, a personal escort and unit that took orders directly from Isildur.

1879214594.name: Piercing Strike
1879214594.desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879214978.name: Improved Turn the Tables
1879214978.desc: When dazed, stunned, knocked down, or knocked out you may turn the tables on your enemy, recovering from the effects and instilling them in your enemy. This attack can not be Blocked, Parried, Evaded or Miss an on level opponent.

conditionalEffects.description: Turn the Tables grants immunity to all disables for 10s.

1879248386.name: Spread of Arrows - Light
1879248386.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Light-based damage projectiles toward your target.

1879284098.name: Banner - Engineer
1879284098.desc: Place a banner that improves Engineers.

procEffects.description: DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff
Healing skills have a  *  chance to make your next damaging skill crit.
DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff

1879301250.name: Return to Helm's Deep
1879301250.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Helmingas, you're able to quickly return to Helm's Deep in western Rohan. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879316482.name: Grim
1879316482.desc: Summons a grim to your side. A jacket is recommended.

1879324034.name: Tan Sheep
1879324034.desc: Summons a sheep to keep you company.

1879329154.name: Muster in Minas Tirith
1879329154.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Minas Tirith.

1879329794.name: Green Beetle
1879329794.desc: Summons a beetle to keep you company.

1879369986.name: Farmers Feast Steed
1879369986.desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.

1879394562.name: Steed of the Autumn Traveller
1879394562.desc: A noble fallow deer dressed for the season.

1879449986.name: Broad Thrash - Tier 3 (Dual)
1879449986.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.
Thrash deals extra damage to targets affected by Claw Swipe.

1879466242.name: Flick
1879466242.desc: With a quick flick of your blade, interrupt your target's focus.

1879467266.name: The West Wind
1879467266.desc: Sing to West Wind, on which flows the call To Arms, strengthening your allies.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's To Arms Damage buff.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Calling to one of the winds will restore some of your morale.
Shanties briefly reduce the Damage you receive.
Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.
Shanties remove one negative effect from each affected ally.

1879475970.name: Return to Halrax
1879475970.desc: You're able to quickly return to Halrax in the Shield Isles. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879489154.name: Noble Purpose
1879489154.desc: Your companion lends you a piece of their nobility, granting you a small measure of hope and comfort even in dark times.

1879491074.name: Ametrine Drakeling
1879491074.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879508098.name: Long Shot: Flaming Arrow
1879508098.desc: Nock and loose an imprecise dart, which has a chance to greatly increase your Focus if it lands.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879508738.name: Return to Zajâna
1879508738.desc: You're able to quickly return to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879518722.name: Aradûni Battle-horn
1879518722.desc: Use to rally the allied soldiers in Emax Dûl.

1879525122.name: Rotten Fruit
1879525122.desc: The traditional critic's commentary on a poor performance. Also works great on friends.

1879525378.name: White Tree Fireworks
1879525378.desc: Set off some festive tree-shaped fireworks!
